Eleven comments

The Devilll For My Hurt

This tune comes from Olllam’s recording called “the olllam”.
It seems to be composed by John McSherry.
I think this tune is not very easy to learn because of the strange time signature and the unusual key, but this is a great tune. On their recording, they played it on low D whistle and Uilleann Pipes in D… absolutely torturous… great musicians. :)

↳ Posted by duby on February 16th, 2015.

Thanks Sébastien.. You did a great job transposing this tune! It’s indeed fantastic!

↳ Posted by MarcusDisessa on February 21st, 2015.

The Devilll For My Hurt, X:3

Corrected a few wrong notes (primarily the first, fifth and seventh bars of the second section), changed some held notes to repeated notes where I felt it was important, removed superfluous key change, removed ornaments.

Thanks to duby for the original transcription - would have been utterly impossible for me to do from scratch! :)

The Devilll For My Hurt, X:4

Transposed first setting for D finger work on a C whistle

↳ Posted by magnus on July 10th, 2024.

Re: The Devilll For My Hurt

Much more manageable to play on a low D if you tape the E hole half closed. Lets you finger the F as the usual F#
The other hard note Bb never gets used (or just once if you go with the first setting) but the B is used a lot so that works as normal - for that reason, it might be better to consider the tune to be in D Dorian rather than Dmin/Aeolian (though with a lot of C#s)

↳ Posted by Kynan on October 31st, 2024.
